reviews.t: a marketing campaign masquerading as a personal grooming product
reviews.x: The rotary trimmer cuts literally nothing, it's less useful than the $10 throwaway ones you can get at CVS. The other trimmer is no better than the cheap drugstore ones either. The guard is flimsy plastic and not really usefully adjustable, you can't really disassemble it easily for cleaning, you need a USB cable to charge it, and the on/off switch is easy to turn on accidentally in a travel bag unless you do some combination of clicks to lock it and unlock it, where it could have just used a sl

It’s alright, no complaints. It just pulls some hair rather than a smooth cut causing bumps. Just like all the old ones. The battery has not needed charged yet so that is great. Ear and nose trimmer takes a lot of slow work to get the Hair and misses some regularly.

Thats all these are is blown up hype, dont fall for it. The nose/ear trimmers just dont work, the lawn mower works ok but ok is not what I paid for. For famn near $100 I want damn good and this falls short.  NOT RECOMMEND USE IN THE SHOWER

[[VIDEOID:dbb8ac3f70bdf066f4c48a148e88e822]] Great value for the money. Tip: if you're not a reader like me, the lawn mower will likely come with travel lock engaged. Simply tap the power button 3 times to unlock. After a full charge, I've used the lawn mower a handful of times and still don't need to charge.  Lawn mower seems to have a better value than the weed whacker. So if you're debating on which bundle to buy, the lawn mower is a great value on it's own.  The weed whacker doesn't have muc

The body hair trimmer is good. It is reasonably quiet, trims well, and the built-in light is very helpful.  The nose hair trimmer is misnamed, as it does not trim nose hair. In fact, it doesn't seem to trim any hair whatsoever. The free add-in trimmer I got with a beard trimming case 15 years ago still does a better job than this overpriced piece of plastic.

reviews.t: Is not a bulletproof solution, but it does the job well
reviews.x: I read a lot before buying it, especially the negative reviews about cuts and so on. Well, you operate in a delicate area, don’t use the machine like you’d use a bulldozer and all will be fine.  I used other products before and maybe others after this one. All of them have cutting blades, so you need some extra care. This one the same like others is prone to injure you IF you’re not “gentle” about.  As per machine construction this is excellent, sturdy, good battery life, excellent blades.

This is a must for trimming! I have never in my life felt more confident trimming with these tools. Worked so well and I look forward now to trimming and using this product! Top notch and worth every penny! Very easy to use and well made!

reviews.t: Battery falls well short of expectations
reviews.x: I enjoyed the comfort and ease of use with this product, However, it could not complete the desired jobs on a single charge. I'm not overly hairy, but in attempting to groom multiple locations,  this required putting back on the charger and turning to my over ten year old Wahl trimmer... which by the way Easily completes this same routine at least 3 times before requiring Recharging. IMHO... a ten year old battery shouldn't even come close to managing a process that a Brand New battery Can't do

I only use the lawnmower for around my ears, above my manhood, and for trimming my facial hair if it's too long before using a razor. Below the deck the trimmer is a chore, and I've had much better success using a manual razor there. The other trimmer works well for my nose. They both have a quality feel to them but make no mistake a lot of the price is in the marketing! There's others out there that do the same thing for a lot less. It's nice that the trimmer has a light on it, but it'd be even
This is a must have for men. Both items have great battery life. Both can be used in the shower, and you get a product that ACTUALLY does what they say it will do. Great Job Manscape
Shaved my berries and nose. Wasn’t anything outstanding though. I’d rate average in comparison to others.
Both trimmers work well, but the nose hair trimmer is a little underpowered.

reviews.t: I wanted it to be amazing as their advertising
reviews.x: So I’ve been following manscaped for a couple of years and have always been interested in their products, both on design, their specifications, and their advertising.  I was honestly pretty dissatisfied by both the Lawnmower and their nose tool. I’ll give my personal non biased pros and cons on the Lawnmower because that’s where I would like to discuss my experience.  Lawnmower Pros: the battery life is amazing, I haven’t charged mine in a month and it still has battery life. Also the led light

I enjoy this product very much It’s luxury products Great features and design Fits in the hand perfectly and size allows it to easily get in hard to reach areas I use no guard Pinches are less but it does happen However no pinches with the guard I would highly recommend if you want a luxury brand name trimmer specifically designed for body and groin These two products meet an exceed all my needs

reviews.t: I, previously, did a BAD review.  I am here to REPENT!  his product is GR8T!
reviews.x: I thought it had self-destructed but I was wrong and the fine folks at Manscape corrected my misgivings!  I was the actual problem with the product.  GOTTA READ THEN INSTRUCTIONS was the last thing I heard from the ol battle axe!
Very slick ads for this product. I bought two of each as gifts. None held a charge for long. On / off did not work on any of it. Poor quality “made in China” junk.

I think that this pack is a great option for people who don't really know what they need and just want a easy solution. It comes with everything you would need for grooming the body, as well as some neat features. The razer comes with a light that shines on where you are shaving, and I think this is super neat. Comes with a lot of guards and is very easy to clean.

Does not trim safely as highly advertised!!!! This will cut you just like the rest of them. They spend a fortune on advertising so you will believe they work great. Unfortunately I didn’t read reviews before buying and ended up with an $80 trimmer that is worthless. Do your homework before wasting your money. I hoped it would perform as advertised.

Got as a gift for my husband. He talked about this brand with his friends for a while I figured I’d give it a try. He loves it! He got a Stand for it and uses it daily! He loves the nose trimmers and the hair trimmers. Cuts great, long lasting charge and water resistant for use in shower. If your thinking about them just get it! 100% recommend.

reviews.t: It's just a trimmer with a catchy name
reviews.x: Works like any other trimmer, it will cut you! Buy a cheaper trimmer without a catchy name. It's the same....The only reason I bought this set is I had a few gift cards that brought down the crazy price. Don't spend that much money on this pair of trimmers. You can find it cheaper elsewhere, they are the same!!

Great value in a combo and wow, I'm impressed if you've been on the fence about manscaping products these are it! I've used other brands and those are junk compared to these. No nics, cuts on sensitive parts and cuts the hair like barber hair clippers. Get one!

Trimmer worked perfect. Great battery life, easy to use for 4 weeks. Now there charging light will not turn off, while the timer is off. So the light is on but when I press the power button, nothing happens. Trimmer does not turn on nor does the flash light.

My husband wanted it and got it. He says it works well and easy to use. I do enjoy the art created using it. I think it's rather expensive but then again I guess you want quality equipment handling the family jewels. Sorry no pictures.
Litteraly makes trimming more painstakingly longer. Takes more time. Misses some hairs. Just over all poor quality and not as advertised. I would rather call this trimmer basic than a lawnmower.

reviews.t: Trimmer itself works well but the guards don't work all that well.
reviews.x: Didn't want the full clean look, so I strapped on a guard. But the longer guard doesn't really allow the hair to comb and get cut. The trimmer seems sturdy and is easy to use.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the battery life, saying it lasts through multiple uses on a single charge.
The nose and ear trimmer is a common complaint, with several reviewers saying it is underpowered or fails to trim hair effectively.
Several reviewers feel the product does not live up to its marketing hype or price, calling performance average or disappointing.
Some reviewers report the trimmer pulls hair or causes pinches and bumps rather than cutting smoothly.
A number of reviewers are highly satisfied, calling it well made, easy to use, and worth the money.
